38848-paul-gauguin-his-life-and-art.title: His Life and Art
38848-paul-gauguin-his-life-and-art.creator: Unknown
38848-paul-gauguin-his-life-and-art.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. provisional republic was formed and elections were held to the National Assembly. But the provinces showed that it mattered little to them whether the form of Government was changed or not. So long as the peasant had his farm, his cow, his money safely stowed away in a stocking, a hard-working wife, a pipe and a glass of wine, he was content with things as they were.

arxiv-1901-11482.title: Turbulence-driven ion beams in the magnetospheric Kelvin-Helmholtz instability
arxiv-1901-11482.creator: Luca Sorriso-Valvo, Filomena Catapano, Alessandro Retinò, Olivier Le Contel, Denise Perrone, Owen W. Roberts, Jesse T. Coburn, Vincenzo Panebianco, Oreste Pezzi, Francesco Valentini, Silvia Perri, Antonella Greco, Francesco Malara, Vincenzo Carbone, Pierluigi Veltri, Federico Fraternale, Francesca D
arxiv-1901-11482.description: Abstract The description of the local turbulent energy transfer, and the high-resolution ion distributions measured by the Magnetospheric Multiscale mission, together provide a formidable tool to explore the cross-scale connection between the fluid-scale energy cascade and plasma processes at sub-ion scales.

arxiv-2203-03526.title: On the Conjugacy Search Problem in Extraspecial p p -Groups
arxiv-2203-03526.creator: Simran Tinani
arxiv-2203-03526.description: Abstract In the recently emerging field of group-based cryptography, the Conjugacy Search Problem (CSP) has gained traction as a non-commutative replacement of the Discrete Log Problem (DLP). The problem of finding a secure class of nonabelian groups for use as platforms is open and a subject of active research.

arxiv-2502-01867.title: Optimizing Online Advertising with Multi-Armed Bandits: Mitigating the Cold Start Problem under Auction Dynamics
arxiv-2502-01867.creator: Anastasiia Soboleva, Pudovikov Andrey, Roman Snetkov, Alina Babenko, Egor Samosvat, Yuriy Dorn
arxiv-2502-01867.description: Abstract Online advertising platforms often face a common challenge: the cold start problem. Insufficient behavioral data (clicks) makes accurate click-through rate (CTR) forecasting of new ads challenging. CTR for "old" items can also be significantly underestimated due to their early performance influencing their long-term behavior on the platform.

arxiv-2502-15251.title: SiMHand: Mining Similar Hands for Large-Scale 3D Hand Pose Pre-training
arxiv-2502-15251.creator: Nie Lin, Takehiko Ohkawa, Yifei Huang, Mingfang Zhang, Minjie Cai, Ming Li, Ryosuke Furuta & Yoichi Sato
arxiv-2502-15251.description: Abstract We present a framework for pre-training of 3D hand pose estimation from in-the-wild hand images sharing with similar hand characteristics, dubbed SiMHand . Pre-training with large-scale images achieves promising results in various tasks, but prior methods for 3D hand pose pre-training have not fully utilized the potential of diverse hand images accessible from in-the-wild videos.

arxiv-2507-14561.title: A Multidimensional Birkhoff Theorem for Recurrent Lagrangian Submanifolds by a Tonelli Hamiltonian
arxiv-2507-14561.creator: Skander Charfi
arxiv-2507-14561.description: Abstract Consider a closed manifold M M and a time-periodic Tonelli Hamiltonian H : ℝ / ℤ × T ∗ ​ M → ℝ H:\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}\times T^{*}M\to\mathbb{R} with flow ϕ H \phi_{H} . Let ℒ ⊂ T ∗ ​ M \mathcal{L}\subset T^{*}M be a Lagrangian submanifold Hamiltonianly isotopic to the zero section.

arxiv-2603-13505.title: Testing the Exclusion Restriction in IV Models Using Non-Gaussianity: A LiNGAM-Based Approach
arxiv-2603-13505.creator: Fernando Delbianco

pmc-11585949.title: Microcontroller-based water control system for evaluating crop water use characteristics
pmc-11585949.creator: Daisuke Sugiura, Shiro Mitsuya, Hirokazu Takahashi, Ryo Yamamoto, Yoshiyuki Miyazawa
pmc-11585949.description: BackgroundClimate change and the growing demand for agricultural water threaten global food security. Understanding water use characteristics of major crops from leaf to field scale is critical, particularly for identifying crop varieties with enhanced water-use efficiency (WUE) and stress tolerance.

pmc-11721057.title: Trends in Cardiovascular Diseases and Costs Among Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) Patients in Malaysia: A Cohort Study of 240,611 Public Hospital Inpatients
pmc-11721057.creator: Noor Adilah Kamarudin, Sharifa Ezat Wan Puteh, Mohd Rizal Abd Manaf, Mohd Ridzwan Shahari
pmc-11721057.description: Background: Identifying trends of hospital admissions and costs for cardiovascular disease events (CVDEs) is crucial for public health intervention and the economic burden for future clinical improvements and better outcomes. This study aims to define the admission trends and cost of CVDE among type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) patients in Malaysia between 2014 and 2020.

pmc-12365274.title: Facial features associated with fear and happiness attract gaze during brief exposure without enhancing emotion recognition
pmc-12365274.creator: Yu-Fang Yang, Matthias Gamer
pmc-12365274.description: Facial features transmit emotions but their effect on visual orienting and explicit emotion recognition is debated. Here we examined whether fixating on diagnostic features of emotional expressions—such as eye region for fear and the mouth for happiness—affects saccadic targeting and improves recognition accuracy.

pmc-12541986.title: Reduced need for inpatient care following introduction of long-acting injectable buprenorphine
pmc-12541986.creator: Emelie Gauffin, Antonio Marques Franca, Elena Pizzaro Ferrero, Zeb Freij, Isa Pihlflyckt, Mikael Sandell, Charlotte Gedeon, He Zhang, David Andersson, Gustav Tinghög, Andrea Johansson Capusan
pmc-12541986.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundGrowing evidence supports long-acting injectable (LAI) buprenorphine in opioid use disorder treatment. Implementation is limited due to concerns about costs as well as potential reduction of support, which could increase strain on health care services.

pmc-12568536.title: Characteristics and mechanisms of liver injury caused by emerging infectious diseases
pmc-12568536.creator: Yi Cheng, Xin Zheng
pmc-12568536.description: Abnormal liver function has become a common phenomenon in emerging infectious diseases caused by viruses, with incidence rates ranging from 2.5% to 98.6% across different pathogens. This review summarized the characteristics of liver injury caused by SARS-CoV-2, MERS-CoV, H7N9, SFTSV, DENV, and EBOV viruses.

pmc-12706927.title: Unveiling hepatitis E virus diversity in Sudan’s internally displaced populations: a molecular epidemiology approach
pmc-12706927.creator: Hytham A. Osman, Wafaa M. K. Bakr, Mona H. Hashish, Isam M. Elkhidir, Shahinaz Bedri, Samuel O. Oyola, Helene Norder, Ekram W. Abd El-Wahab
pmc-12706927.description: BackgroundHepatitis E virus (HEV) is recognized as a cause of acute viral hepatitis, particularly in low-resource and humanitarian settings, although its burden varies across different populations and geographic areas. Internally displaced persons (IDPs) are at high risk due to inadequate sanitation and contaminated water.

pmc-13090807.title: Navigating Practical, Political, and Ethical Challenges of Long‐Term Human Biology Field Research: The Shuar Health and Life History Project
pmc-13090807.creator: J Josh Snodgrass, Felicia C Madimenos, Melissa A Liebert, Samuel S Urlacher, Tara J Cepon‐Robins, Theresa E Gildner, Richard G Bribiescas, Lawrence S Sugiyama
pmc-13090807.description: Major advances in understanding human biology and health have been made possible by long‐term field research projects with Indigenous peoples, whose ecological settings and lifeways are distinct from majority populations in high‐income settings. Long‐term fieldwork is central to human biology, yet much about this research approach remains opaque.

pmc-13341156.title: Reported symptoms and patterns of language impairment in bilingual speakers with primary progressive aphasia: a retrospective study
pmc-13341156.creator: Jessica de Leon, Isabel Elaine Allen, Zachary Miller, Nina Dronkers, Maya Henry, Maria Luisa Gorno-Tempini, Stephanie Grasso

pmc-13407829.title: Artificial intelligence and transforming cancer care
pmc-13407829.creator: Aneesha Mallu Reddy, Gurleen Kaur, Vincent Sean D Ribaya, Elizabeth Laurize A Ribaya, Mallu Chenna Reddy, Tariq Shah, Dheeraj Shinde, Gurparsad Singh Suri
pmc-13407829.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping oncology by addressing key limitations in traditional cancer care and enabling data-driven, personalized approaches from diagnosis to treatment. This review explores the transformative role of AI across the cancer care continuum, highlighting its contributions, challenges, and future directions.

pmc-13458421.title: Liver Fat Changes in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes by Presence of Genetic Hepatic Steatosis: A Post Hoc Analysis of SURPASS‐3 MRI
pmc-13458421.creator: Kenneth Cusi, Amalia Gastaldelli, Laura Fernández Landó, Palash Sharma, Amelia Torcello‐Gómez, Ángel Rodríguez
pmc-13458421.description: The patatin‐like phospholipase 3 (PNPLA3) I148M genetic variant is highly associated with steatotic liver disease. In the SURPASS‐3 MRI substudy, tirzepatide significantly reduced liver fat content (LFC) versus insulin degludec in insulin‐naïve patients with type 2 diabetes with metabolic dysfunction‐associated steatotic liver disease. The influence of PNPLA3 I148M allele on changes in LFC in response to tirzepatide is unknown.

pmc-13483454.title: Green mycosynthesis of small-sized silver nanoparticles (ss-AgNPs) from endophytic Fusarium solani and their multi-target biomedical profiles
pmc-13483454.creator: Tarkeshwari A Madavi, Sachin T Yerpude, Utpal J Dongre, Vijay J Upadhye, Alok R Rai
pmc-13483454.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The present work focuses on the mycosynthesis, physicochemical profiling and biological evaluation of small-sized silver nanoparticles (ss-AgNPs) synthesized through a fungal-mediated green approach using endophytic Fusarium solani. The UV–Visible spectrum exhibited a distinct surface plasmon resonance (SPR) peak at 499 nm, indicating the successful reduction of Ag⁺ ions to Ag0, while XRD and TEM analyses revealed crystalline, spherical ss-AgNPs with an average particle size of 6.13 nm and a face-centered cubic (fcc) crystalline structure.
